name: Vital Seed
notes: Vital Seed: +5 maximum HP (and 5 HP back, so a full bar stays full), up to 5 times (+25). Offered on the waves mode's level-up menu (menu_power); its level is kept in 'up_vital' (back to 0 each run). The card doesn't say 'healed': the level-up that opens the menu already heals fully.
title: VITAL SEED
